items.title: Pyro Spellweave (both 1.21.1 and 1.20.1)
items.detail: Spartan Compat module for T.O Magic 'n Extras (traveloptics, an Iron's Spells addon). Each metal gets the full Spartan weapon set, crafted from the T.O ingot with a netherite smithing upgrade. Boss tier like T.O's own weapons: durability 2250, speed 9.0, enchantability 20, rare, explosion proof. Art is Spartan iron recoloured with colours read from T.O's ingot and weapon (T.O art is All Rights Reserved, so no pixels copied). Good ships it; Needs changes gets a repaint; Bad drops this metal. 5.0 damage over netherite base, fireproof, sets targets on fire (ignite). Ingot drops from the Netherite Monstrosity.

items.title: Which T.O metals
items.detail: Every metal T.O has. Default pick: 1.21.1 gets Pyro, Verdant and Void (the only ones that drop there; Tectonic and Hullbreaker are not even registered). 1.20.1 gets all six shown here. Options: Lightning Spellweave (drops from Tremorzilla on 1.20.1, has no source on 1.21.1, no art made yet); Abyssal on 1.21.1 too (creative only there). Skipped: Celestial, Crimson, Cryo, Eldritch, Evokated spellweave, which no version can obtain.
